entries.text_en: The Parties should cooperate to promote a supportive and open international economic system that would lead to sustainable economic growth and development in all Parties, particularly developing country Parties, thus enabling them better to address the problems of climate change. Measures taken to combat climate change, including unilateral ones, should not constitute a means of arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination or a disguised restriction on international trade.
entries.note: يطابق مع النص الرسمي بعد تنزيله.

entries.location: Paragraph 89, section on economic and social consequences of response measures
entries.text_en: Also urges developed country Parties to strive to implement policies and measures to respond to climate change in such a way as to avoid negative social and economic consequences for developing country Parties, taking into account Article 3 of the Convention, and to assist these Parties to address such consequences by providing support, including financial resources, transfer of technology and capacity-building, in accordance with Article 4 of the Convention, to build up the resilience of societies and economies negatively affected by response measures;
entries.note: زودته زميلة، وتأكد جزء من نصه عبر مقتطف بحث. الفقرات التمهيدية المرافقة لم تطابق بعد.

entries.text_en: Recognizes that Parties should cooperate on promoting a supportive and open international economic system aimed at achieving sustainable economic growth and development in all countries and thus enabling them to better to address the problems of climate change, noting that measures taken to combat climate change, including unilateral ones, should not constitute a means of arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination or a disguised restriction on international trade;
entries.note: استخرج عبر محرك البحث من الوثيقة الرسمية. عبارة better to address يرجح أنها في الأصل.

entries.source: G20 Task Force on a Global Mobilization against Climate Change, Ministerial Statement
entries.text_en: Parties should cooperate on promoting a supportive and open international economic system aimed at achieving sustainable economic growth and development in all countries and thus enabling them to better address the problems of climate change, noting that measures taken to combat climate change, including unilateral ones, should not constitute a means of arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination or a disguised restriction on international trade.
entries.note: زودته زميلة. يكاد يطابق 1/CMA.5 الفقرة ١٥٤ حرفيا. رقم الفقرة لم يطابق. الصياغة نفسها وردت في إعلان قادة ريو دي جانيرو نوفمبر ٢٠٢٤ بحسب مصادر ثانوية. لا يدرج في متن قرارات الأمم المتحدة، ويستعمل حجة شفهية.

entries.text_ar: تؤكد من جديد أيضا أن التدابير المتخذة لمكافحة تغير المناخ، بما في ذلك التدابير الأحادية الجانب، لا ينبغي أن تشكل وسيلة للتمييز التعسفي أو غير المبرر أو تقييدا مقنعا للتجارة الدولية
entries.note: تأكد ورود الصياغة في القرار وإطلاق حوارات التدابير التجارية في دورات الهيئات الفرعية ٢٠٢٦ و٢٠٢٧ و٢٠٢٨ مع تقرير موجز ٢٠٢٨، من مصادر ثانوية. رقم الفقرة ورمز المقرر لم يطابقا.

entries.source: Rio Declaration on Environment and Development
entries.text_en: States should cooperate to promote a supportive and open international economic system that would lead to economic growth and sustainable development in all countries, to better address the problems of environmental degradation. Trade policy measures for environmental purposes should not constitute a means of arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination or a disguised restriction on international trade. Unilateral actions to deal with environmental challenges outside the jurisdiction of the importing country should be avoided. Environmental measures addressing transboundary or global environmental problems should, as far as possible, be based on an international consensus.

entries.source: Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
entries.text_en: States are strongly urged to refrain from promulgating and applying any unilateral economic, financial or trade measures not in accordance with international law and the Charter of the United Nations that impede the full achievement of economic and social development, particularly in developing countries.
entries.note: النص مأخوذ من مقتطف بحث، يطابق حرفيا مع القرار.

entries.text_en: Avoiding the creation of barriers to participation in cooperative approaches under Article 6, paragraph 2, by imposing of undue financial burdens on developing country Parties, particularly the least developed countries and small island developing States, that wish to participate;
entries.note: نص مقترح في مستند غير رسمي وليس لغة متفقا عليها. طوبق في 8/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Ensuring that the costs of operation and maintenance of the infrastructure and processes are borne only by Parties and entities participating in or benefiting from cooperative approaches under Article 6, paragraph 2 and not by Parties that do not participate in such approaches;
entries.note: نص مقترح في مستند غير رسمي. طوبق في 8/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Decides that the fee referred to in paragraph 6 above shall be waived for [the least developed countries and small island developing States][developing country Parties];
entries.note: صيغة الفقرة 10، وتتكرر الأقواس نفسها في الفقرات 18 و25 و32. طوبق في 8/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Note that, considering the financial situation of the Article 6.4 mechanism, it could review the application of the exemption of the LDCs and SIDS from the fees pertaining to the share of proceeds for administrative expenses set out in paragraphs 50–55 of the annex to decision 7/CMA.4, as provided for in paragraph 58 thereof, with respect to eligible transitioned CDM activities registered under the Article 6.4 mechanism, while continuing to take into account the special circumstances and needs of the LDCs and SIDS.
entries.note: توصية من هيئة الإشراف إلى CMA 8. طوبق في 8/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Also requests the secretariat, as part of the capacity-building programme referred to in decision 2/CMA.3, paragraph 12(b), to organize a dialogue, to be held in conjunction with each session of the Subsidiary Body for Implementation, among interested participating Parties and observers to exchange information on and experience in how cooperative approaches in which they participate support ambition;
entries.note: ولاية حوار الطموح للمادة 6.2. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 8/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Requests the Subsidiary Body for Scientific and Technological Advice to review the work programme, including its activities, at its sixty-fourth (June 2026) and sixty-fifth (November 2026) sessions with a view to enhancing the effectiveness of the work programme, taking into account relevant inputs, including the outcomes of the global stocktake, and to make recommendations thereon for consideration and adoption by the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement by no later than at its eighth session (2026);
entries.note: ولاية مراجعة برنامج عمل النهج غير السوقية في SBSTA 64 و65. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 9/11/2026.

entries.text_en: In addition, each NMA facilitated under the framework: ... (c) Does not involve the transfer of any mitigation outcomes;
entries.note: الفارق الجوهري بين النهج غير السوقية والمادتين 6.2 و6.4. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 9/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Notes that recording information on a non-market approach or support available or needed on the UNFCCC web-based platform is for information exchange purposes only, and neither creates any rights or obligations for any Party or other entity nor represents endorsement or approval of the non-market approach;
entries.note: التسجيل في المنصة لا ينشئ التزاما. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 9/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Requests the secretariat, subject to the availability of resources, to facilitate opportunities for participating Parties to identify, develop and implement non-market approaches by: (a) Organizing an in-session workshop, including plenary presentations and round-table discussions, to be held in conjunction with each meeting of the Glasgow Committee on Non-market Approaches, to exchange information on the non-market approaches including best practices and lessons learned from identifying, developing and implementing non-market approaches as well as non-market approaches that may require financial, technology and capacity-building support and the support available for such non-market approaches;
entries.note: ولاية ورشة 6.8 أثناء الدورة. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 9/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Recognizes that one non-market approach has been submitted by Parties to the NMA Platform since its recent launch, with submissions anticipated to increase over time;
entries.note: حجم استعمال المنصة عند CMA.6. طوبق مع الوثيقة الرسمية من documents.un.org في 9/11/2026.

entries.text_en: (paraphrase from the concept note) invited Parties and observers to submit views and information on topics for discussion at the in-session workshop to be held in conjunction with GCNMA 10 and requested the secretariat to organize the workshop on the basis of the topics identified.
entries.note: من المذكرة المفاهيمية النهائية لورشة 6.8 في COP31، ولم يطابق نص المقرر.

entries.text_en: Recognizes the need for additional support to be provided to Parties for implementing non-market approaches, in particular: Option 1A: For developing country Parties in the areas of finance, technology development and transfer, and capacity-building, while preserving the voluntary and Party-driven nature of non-market approaches; Option 1B: Predictable, adequate, grant-based and concessional finance [from developed to developing country Parties];
entries.note: نص وثيقة غير رسمية تجمع آراء الأطراف وليس لغة متفقا عليها. قرئت من نسخة المستخدم في Drive (Negotiation-References/Article6) في 10/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Requests the secretariat to develop additional capacity-building activities relevant to implementing Article 6, paragraph 8, including through the regional collaboration centres, by providing training in languages other than English and additional peer-learning opportunities;
entries.note: نص وثيقة غير رسمية تجمع آراء الأطراف وليس لغة متفقا عليها. قرئت من نسخة المستخدم في Drive (Negotiation-References/Article6) في 10/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Applying the user-pays principle, as appropriate, and supporting the progressive self-financing of relevant infrastructure and processes;
entries.note: نص مقترح في مستند غير رسمي. تطلب المجموعة العربية حذفه في مداخلتها المعدة ليوم 11/11/2026. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.location: Annex, draft decision -/CMA.8, approach 1, paragraphs 3 and 4
entries.text_en: Takes note that future programme budget proposals should continue to reflect the resource requirements associated with implementing activities under Article 6, paragraph 2, and those requirements should be considered by Parties in the context of the programme budget process and in line with decision 19/CP.28; Requests the secretariat to continue presenting in future programme budget proposals the full resource requirements associated with the implementation of Article 6.2 activities, with a view to ensuring that the proposed budget adequately reflects the requirements arising from Article 6.2 mandates.
entries.note: نص مقترح للنهج الأول، وتعده المجموعة العربية أقرب منطقة هبوط. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Further decides that, in the event that a participating Party fails to pay the fee referred to in paragraph 6 above, all internationally transferred mitigation outcomes recorded as first transferred and/or as used towards the achievement of a nationally determined contribution or cancelled for other international mitigation purposes shall be flagged as 'inconsistent' in the consistency check reports, including in the annual information of any acquiring participating Parties;
entries.note: نص مقترح عن وسم المعاملات بعدم الاتساق عند عدم الدفع. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Decides that each participating Party, at the time of submission of an initial report or an updated initial report under Article 6, paragraph 2, shall pay a fee for each cooperative approach included in the respective initial report or updated initial report;
entries.note: رسم يستحق عند التقرير الأولي. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Further decides that, in the event that a participating Party fails to pay the fee referred to in paragraph 14 above, the secretariat shall not provide any services related to a cooperative approach for which the fee has not been paid, including suspending access to the international registry by that participating Party;
entries.note: حكم تعليق النفاذ إلى السجل الدولي. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.location: Annex, draft decision -/CMA.8, approach 3, option 1D(a), paragraph 49
entries.text_en: Requests the secretariat to include, in its report referred to in paragraph 48 above for 2028, a detailed assessment of options for making the infrastructure and processes under Article 6, paragraph 2, self-financing, including associated costs, potential sources of revenue, possible financing models, implementation considerations and, as appropriate, recommendations and possible timelines for progressively achieving self-financing, for consideration by the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement at its tenth session;
entries.note: بديله الخيار 1D(b) بلا نص. طوبق في 11/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Decides that no mandatory fee shall be charged to a developing country Party solely for the establishment or maintenance of a Party section in the international registry;
entries.note: نص مقترح في المسودة الأولى لا لغة متفق عليها. طوبق من ملف المسودة في 12/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Requests the secretariat, prior to the establishment or substantive revision of fee levels under this decision, to assess the practical and financial implications of the relevant fee options, including their relationship to the principal cost drivers, expected revenues, administrative costs, possible overlapping charges and potential impacts on participation and user behavior.
entries.note: نص مقترح في المسودة الأولى. طوبق في 12/11/2026.

entries.text_en: Further decides that, in the event that a participating Party fails to pay the fee referred to in paragraph 7 above, all internationally transferred mitigation outcomes recorded as first transferred and/or as used towards the achievement of a nationally determined contribution or cancelled for other international mitigation purposes shall be flagged as 'inconsistent' in the consistency check reports, including in the annual information of any acquiring participating Parties;
entries.note: تعارضه المجموعة العربية بشدة. طوبق في 12/11/2026.
